name: Bryan Collins
tagline: I build and run data businesses with AI coding agents and document the process on YouTube.
intro: I'm a USA Today bestselling author based in Ireland. For most of my career I ran Become a Writer Today. Now I build Irish data products with Claude Code, and film the builds as I go.
Below are the videos, the sites I run, and the open-source agent skills I use every day.

items.name: Vendors.ie
items.desc: The dataset of business software available in Ireland. Verified Irish vendors, compliance mapped across Revenue, PAYE, GDPR and Irish bank feeds, re-checked weekly.

items.name: Tenderwatch.ie
items.desc: Built for Irish SMEs bidding for their first public contracts. Live tender feed, a plain-English jargon translator, bid or no-bid scoring and readiness checks.

items.name: Leinster Insider
items.desc: Leinster town by town: what to do, and what it actually costs to live there, from official house prices, rents and yields.

items.name: becomeawriter.com
items.desc: Freelance writing and content-marketing jobs from 14 boards and career pages. Deduplicated, scam-filtered, pay listed first, published every Tuesday.

items.name: AI Flash Report
items.desc: A tracker for frontier AI model releases, with benchmarks, pricing and launch coverage.

items.name: Wellkept
items.desc: A one-off website health check for Irish small businesses. Speed, security, email delivery, broken forms and what Google sees, for a flat fee.

items.name: Become a Writer Today
items.desc: The site I built and ran for most of my career. Now a set of free tools for writers: living databases of contests, literary magazines and residencies, word banks and an editing sandbox.

items.name: Prompt Writing Studio
items.desc: Working guides and templates for Claude Code, MCP, skills and sub-agents.

items.name: Reading Curator
items.desc: Book discovery: authors similar to the ones you like, and curated reading lists.

items.name: FluentAtDesk
items.desc: Templates and tools for professionals who write at work in their second language.

items.name: My Triathlon Calculator
items.desc: Free race-day calculators for triathletes: sweat rate, electrolytes, carb timing and pacing.

items.name: Glitch Text Generator
items.desc: A small, silly Zalgo text tool. Proof that not everything needs a business model.

books.title: The Power of Creativity

books.desc: The craft and the business of a writing career.

work.headline: I build products, grow audiences and ship with AI.
work.summary: Product and growth operator. I ran a media business for most of my career, and I now build data products end to end with AI coding agents. Everything below is live and you can check it.
work.open_to: I'm open to product leadership and head of growth roles, contract or full time.

roles.title: Founder and editor
points: Bootstrapped a media company with a team of freelance writers and editors.
Launched digital courses and products, and ran the SEO and newsletter operation behind them.
Rebuilt the site from WordPress to a static Astro site of free, data-backed tools for writers.

roles.title: Founder, Consistent Publishing Ltd
points: Build and operate Vendors.ie, Tenderwatch.ie and Leinster Insider: scrapers, data pipelines, SSR sites, email and payments.
Ship with Claude Code as the builder: PRDs, parallel agents, review gates and monitoring I wrote myself.
Publish the reusable parts as MIT-licensed agent skills, and film the builds for YouTube.
